remarks: Freshly updated with a price improvement, 130 Main Street Unit E4 is the opportunity you've been waiting for. This move-in ready 2-bedroom, 2.5-bath townhouse with a two-car garage delivers the perfect blend of style, space, and convenience. The main level showcases gleaming hardwood floors and an effortless open layout ideal for entertaining and everyday living. The kitchen features a center island and flows seamlessly into the dining area with sliders to a private balcony-perfect for morning coffee or evening unwinding. The living room is elevated by elegant coffered ceilings, adding a sophisticated touch. Upstairs, the spacious primary suite offers a walk-in closet and private bath, while a second bedroom, full hall bath, and in-unit laundry provide comfort and ease. The expansive third-floor loft is a true bonus-ideal as a guest suite, home office, or flexible living space. Enjoy year-round comfort with a 3-zone HVAC system and unbeatable commuter convenience with easy access to I-95, the Merritt Parkway, and nearby train stations. Stylish, versatile, and now priced to move-don't miss it!
